title: Edit Distance Transform - Solution
intuition: Given two strings word1 and word2, return the minimum number of operations required to convert word1 to word2. Operations are insert, delete, replace.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use 2D DP. dp[i][j] holds edit distance for prefixes. If chars match, dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]. Else, 1 + min(insert, delete, replace).
